overview: This 350-page file traces U.S. and Allied efforts to dismantle Japan’s war industry while rebuilding a self-supporting economy from 1947 to 1949. It documents disputes over reparations, industrial limits, shipping, deconcentration, and recovery, alongside foreign reactions, production reports, Japanese industrial legislation, and a technical white paper.
interest: Policy disputes sit alongside foreign criticism and Japanese accounts of factory conditions, showing how industrial recovery was negotiated and experienced.
